reviews.text: My dog has autoimmune disorder and cannot have shots nor be around other dogs so we have to do mobile grooming . I can say enough great things about what a wonderful woof. Cara is so kind and genuinely cares about our dog . She also does the BEST job of any groomer we have had prior. Highly recommend !!

Baxter looks so good after his groomings!  And we love the safe and secure feeling of having it done right in our driveway.  We don’t have to leave him somewhere for hours, where he may be caged and scared.  Glad we found What a Wonderful Woof.❤️

Would highly recommend! The team has been fantastic, and have given personalized care and attention to my dog’s unique needs. They have consistently given him the best haircut he’s ever gotten! Thank you so much for taking such good care of my pup!

This is my go to place for dog grooming. I've been bringing my dog here since she was a puppy. The shop is nice and very clean, much cleaner than the other grooming places I considered. They are very good with her, and she always looks great when I pick her up. I also love that they are easy to reach via text. This makes scheduling very easy, and they send a picture when they're done, so if you have any concerns about the look or something, you can tell them before you get there.
Lastly, I just want to note that I live nearby, so I just take my dog there. I haven't used the mobile service.

First time customer and understand mistakes happen but it just hasn’t sat right with me how things were handled. I was sent a text letting me know my dog was ready to be picked up along with a photo. It wasn’t until I arrived that I was told my dog had jumped off and gotten his rear nail caught as well as somehow cut his inner thigh. The groomer was apologetic and said she would be sure to use a different harness next time and that she had put powder on his nail and applied pressure and was able to get the bleeding to stop and shouldn’t require a vet visit. However, no one called to follow up and see how my dog is doing which is disheartening.

what a wonderful experience! Molly has never been softer and her coat never been silkier. At 100 #s i know she is a handful, but she had a great experience with you! Usually she is all stressed out after being groomed, but she was quite happy and relaxed! Thank you for making her look so beautiful and smell so great.

Dusty and Maple loved their bath! Our groomer was amazing! she took the time to ask us exactly what we wanted for each of them, and she completely delivered! They both looked so adorable when we picked them up.
I’m so sorry I forgot your name! 😭 Hopefully I’ll remember to ask next time because I would definitely love to have the same groomer again. You can tell she really cares about what she does and was so sweet with our pups.

Thank you all so much for being so kind and taking such great care of Dusty and Maple! We’ll definitely be back! ❤️🐾

Monica was amazing and great with our dog.

Great job all the time, had a few different  ladies and all did an excellent job
Very friendly  and place is a always clean. Thank you  see you soon.

Management has a serious attitude problem. I agree with other reviews they are uncooperative And honestly a little arrogant. And the prices are ridiculous because there is no negotiating for various issues and they vary.
Whether in the salon or the mobile truck, the groomers always do an amazing job!!

First time coming in today. Was very happy of the outcome of my dog, thank you Monica for doing such an amazing job

I have been a loyal customer for one of my two dogs for about year and just started bringing my second dog here. I’ve been early to nearly every appointment, never complained, and I have always tipped the groomers generous amounts that ranged from $80 to $100 per appointment for just 1 of the two dogs and even more when I brought both dogs on the same day.

Both dogs were groomed by Madison who did a great job and was the reason I continued going back. However, when Madison left the shop I was never notified until I asked where she was because I had not seen her for a couple of appointments. They told me she left the shop because it was too far of a commute. Madison never came back so unbeknownst to me they automatically assigned a new groomer to both of my dogs. Their lack of transparency hasn’t sat right with me since.

Today 2025-12-27, I ended up being late for an appointment. When I called to explain what happened and that I could bring the dogs in immediately which would have been 30 minutes after the appointment had started, I was shown no compassion, no understanding, and they didn’t even attempt to work with me to find a solution. They showed more interest in policing their late and no show policies.

The lessons I’ve learned is that no matter how loyal of a customer you are to this shop and no matter how well you take care of their employees by tipping generous amounts, if you’re late (15 minutes) for the first time, they will show their true colors, treat you badly and provide you with no solutions. I’m now motivated and inclined to spend my money where I feel it and myself are valued.

Customer loyalty is #1 and when you lose it it’s gone forever. You need to do better! Especially when a customer like myself takes such good care of your staff.

Amazing , Amazing , Amazing !!!!

In the age of social media and digital marketing, with reviews at the customer's disposal, it is probably a really tough time for the whole "Under New Management" rebranding to salvage the client base strategy. With that said, this pet salon has a bad review due to them. First off, the Groomer, Otter, has been so wonderful. However, the owners have been nothing short of rude and pompous. We have been taking our dog Arie there for years. There has never been a pricing menu; in fact, their website states prices vary by dog. The owners told us that their employee Otter, who is fantastic by the way, was charging us at a discount. This was news to us, and we had never asked for a discount. I don't place much value on positive reviews on Google, as business owners could easily give their own. I enjoy supporting small businesses as much as I enjoy advocating as a community stakeholder. Brick and mortar businesses are hurting, though service businesses have a unique opportunity to find the right balance of quality in service and customer interaction. The corporate governance of a regulated business model appeals to me when trust is broken. Barbering is a recession-proof industry, and to a point, pet care can enjoy much of that recession resilience. They had a location, great employees, and a loyal client base.
As the saying goes, the fish rots at the head. Yes, I did ask questions when my family was made to feel defensive, and yes, I was courteous. However, the owners of this business have taken to responding to a review that my family made, and somehow positioned me to take sides. Family comes first, Ladies. I would note that these Google reviews mention the groomer Otter a lot and in a positive way; perhaps the owners could do a better job mentoring their key asset, which ultimately is their staff, as they are the face, the service provider, and the reason clients have trust. When asking for Otter the groomer, please encourage her to be up front with pricing, if anything, to keep the owners out of the conversation. Again, we had no idea what the pricing was other than what was being charged, and shame on the owners for being vague and elusive in pricing to begin with. This was never the staff's or the customer's responsibility. It seems simple enough to sketch out a pricing structure other than using whatever we want until we want a more suitable pricing model. Telling us it is not fair to other customers who pay more was a mistake that brought you a lot of word-of-mouth advertising. I am genuinely disappointed that trust was broken, as we have been so pleased with the service in the past, and a price increase was never going to impact our continued relationship. Sometimes, small business owners are small business owners because no one would hire them for their social skills. Customer beware, and always value trust over price and convenience. My review is fair and honest, reflecting my experience. Please feel free to support local businesses, as our local economy needs them. However, never compromise your standards for convenience as a community stakeholder, expecting anything less than the best.

***Edited based on owners response***

I agree, our versions differ, it was not about the amount, it was the way you spoke to me. How rude and dismissive. You attempting to reframe this doesn’t work in that we both acknowledge I have been happily using you TWO TIMES A MONTH for 3 years and this is the only negative Google review (all of my others are 5 stars)  I have ever written! Do you know how badly I feel I was treated to leave a negative review???

End Rant! ****

When I asked about the change, I was told the previous pricing was a “mistake” and that I could take it or leave it. The tone and approach felt dismissive and left me disappointed, especially after years of loyalty and referrals to friends.

I value good grooming for my dog, but also consistency, respect, and trust. Sadly, I no longer feel this location aligns with those values and will be looking for another service.

Hi Sandy,
We’re sorry to hear you felt the need to leave a 1-star review. We always strive to provide excellent service, but we also have to maintain clear boundaries to ensure fairness and respect for our groomers and clients alike.

Unfortunately, repeated last-minute cancellations, no-shows, and consistently arriving late—despite multiple reminders and a final warning—put a strain on our schedule and impact other clients. At your most recent appointment, when we kindly informed you that we could no longer continue the grooming relationship, you responded with profanity toward our team. That behavior is something we do not tolerate.

We wish you and your pup all the best in finding a grooming service that better aligns with your schedule and expectations.
